headline: FinCEN sanctions dozens of individuals and entities linked to Iran's shadow banking networks
summary: The US Treasury Department imposed new Iran-related sanctions on dozens of individuals and entities linked to shadow banking networks. The action was announced on Monday.
why: US sanctions on Iran restrict access to the dollar system and can disrupt financial flows and trade for targeted networks. Such measures are closely watched by investors exposed to Iran-linked trade and energy.
original_headline: FinCEN sanciona a decenas de personas y entidades vinculadas a redes bancarias en la sombra de Irán
